card.name: Digits inside ISSN, ISBN and phone numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or hyphens in the middle of ISSN or ISBN codes in citations, and in hyphenated phone numbers such as 1-877-244-9825. Weaker on a few stray words in notice text.

modes.label: ISSN/ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit or hyphen partway through a journal or book identifier in a reference list.

modes.label: Phone number hyphen
modes.description: A hyphen inside a toll-free contact number in a label.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of long reference or phone numbers, such as journal ISSNs and toll-free lines.
